title: Unilever Posts 13.3B Euro Q3 Revenue, Boosts Full-Year Growth Outlook
summary: Driven by strong performance in beauty and personal care, Unilever raised its full-year forecast, projecting at least 3 percent volume growth for 2026.

extraction.key_fact: 유니레버가 뷰티와 퍼스널케어 호조로 연간 성장 전망을 상향했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Driven by strong performance in beauty and personal care, Unilever raised its full-year forecast, projecting at least 3 percent volume growth for 2026.
